title: Site Commissioning Form
subtitle: Offline Field Capture · Philippine Rural Solar Program
description: Standard 3-section offline field commissioning protocol for solar home systems and cooperative mini-grids.
author: Cost Plus, Inc. Engineering Operations

sections.title: Construction
sections.description: Contractor mobilisation, solar foundation milestones & earthing installation

fields.label: Contractor Mobilised date
fields.helpText: Official date contractor deployed personnel and equipment to site

validation.message: Contractor Mobilised date cannot be in the future

fields.label: Solar Foundation — start date
fields.helpText: Date foundation ground-breaking or civil works began

validation.message: Solar Foundation start date is required
Solar Foundation start date cannot be in the future
Solar Foundation start is never earlier than Contractor Mobilised date

fields.label: Solar Foundation — end date
fields.helpText: Date foundation civil works, curing and anchoring completed

validation.message: Solar Foundation end date is required
Solar Foundation end date cannot be in the future
Solar Foundation end date is never earlier than its start date

fields.label: Earthing Works
fields.helpText: Specify whether earthing and ground protection works were executed

fields.label: Type of Earthing
fields.helpText: Select earthing methodology deployed on site

validation.message: Type of Earthing is required when Earthing Works is Yes

fields.label: Earthing Nos
fields.helpText: Number of earthing points installed (generates Section C photo slots)

validation.message: Earthing Nos is required when Earthing Works is Yes

sections.title: Utility Installation
sections.description: Energy Storage Systems (ESS), solar module rating & PV capacity calculation

fields.label: ESS (Energy Storage System)
fields.helpText: Indicate if battery energy storage units were installed

fields.label: No of ESS Installed
fields.helpText: Select number of battery units (1 to 10)

validation.message: Number of ESS installed is required when ESS is Yes

fields.label: Panel Capacity
fields.helpText: Nominal peak wattage rating per solar module

fields.label: Number of Solar Panels
fields.helpText: Total count of solar PV modules installed on structure

validation.message: Number of Solar Panels is required
Number of Solar Panels must be at least 1
Number of Solar Panels must be a whole integer

fields.label: Solar PV Capacity
fields.helpText: System rating: (Panel Capacity × Number of Panels) ÷ 1000

sections.title: Photos
sections.description: Audit photo evidence. Every outstanding slot must be captured before submission.

photoGroups.title: Foundation
photoGroups.description: Civil & structural foundation verification photos (4 required)

slots.label: Excavation
slots.description: Trench / pit depth and soil preparation

slots.label: Steel Binding
slots.description: Rebar cage and structural steel binding

slots.label: Raft / Column
slots.description: Concrete pour, column alignment and curing

slots.label: Bolts / Pedestal
slots.description: Anchor bolts, pedestal level and torque markings

photoGroups.title: Structure
photoGroups.description: Solar mounting structure elevation verification (2 required)

slots.label: Front
slots.description: Full front elevation showing panel orientation

slots.label: Side
slots.description: Side elevation showing tilt angle and bracing

photoGroups.title: Earthing
photoGroups.description: Earthing ground connection verification. Appears only when Earthing Works is Yes.
